# asc_role (Data Source)

Reads a role and its associated permissions from the authorization service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing role by name
data "asc_role" "example" {
  name = "vm-operator"
}

# Output the role details
output "role_name" {
  description = "The name of the role"
  value       = data.asc_role.example.name
}

output "role_actions" {
  description = "The permission actions assigned to the role"
  value       = data.asc_role.example.actions
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the role to look up.

### Read-Only

- `actions` (List of String) The list of permission actions assigned to this role.
